labels.text: Section 6334(a)(3) as increased by section 6334(g): the aggregate value of books and tools necessary for the trade, business or profession of the taxpayer exempt from levy. Only the published figures of the Revenue Procedures pinned in `us.irc.inflation_adjustments` are recorded (2025: Rev. Proc. 2024-40; 2026: Rev. Proc. 2025-32); other years are outside the declared coverage, so evaluation gives no value rather than an unsourced figure. See TECH-GAPS.md G5605.
Rev. Proc. 2024-40 section 2.50: for calendar year 2025 the value of property exempt from levy under section 6334(a)(3) cannot exceed $5,860
Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 4.49: for calendar year 2026 the value of property exempt from levy under section 6334(a)(3) cannot exceed $5,990
